plan.title: Auto title truncates long product names

steps.note: Open the single-stage create screen specified by the case.
Switch the default event type to RFQ.
Choose the offered RFQ template so the product sheet is available.
Add the mapped product and quantity while leaving the title field untouched for auto-generation.
Select the delivery location required for the generated title.
Confirm the location selection succeeded before checking the auto title.

args.label: Enter the title of this event

steps.note: Verify that the automatically generated title includes the selected delivery location; the exact truncation transformation is not expressible.
